Email.footer: You receive this email because you have an account with {product}. You can manage email notifications in your settings.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email for alerts
verify_email.heading: Confirm this email address
verify_email.body: {email} was added as an alert recipient. Confirm it to start receiving uptime alerts here. If you did not expect this, ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {product}
welcome.heading: Welcome aboard
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Add your first monitor and we will tell you the moment something goes down.

monitor_down.subject: {monitor} is down
monitor_down.heading: {monitor} is down
monitor_down.body: We could not reach {url} at {time}. Reason: {reason}.

payment_succeeded.subject: Payment received
payment_succeeded.heading: Thank you, payment received
payment_succeeded.body: Your payment for the {plan} plan was successful.

payment_failed.subject: Payment failed
payment_failed.heading: We could not take your payment
payment_failed.body: Your payment for the {plan} plan failed (attempt {attempt} of 3). Please update your payment method to keep your plan.

subscription_canceled.subject: Your subscription was canceled
subscription_canceled.heading: Subscription canceled
subscription_canceled.body: Your {plan} plan has ended and your account is now on the Free plan. Monitors above the Free limit were paused, not deleted.

trial_ending.subject: Your free trial ends in {days} days
trial_ending.heading: Your trial is ending soon
trial_ending.body: Your free trial ends in {days} days. Unless you cancel, your paid plan will start and your payment method will be charged.

limit_warning.subject: You have reached a plan limit
limit_warning.heading: Plan limit reached
limit_warning.body: You tried to go beyond your plan's limit ({limit}). Upgrade your plan to continue.
